newsitem.title: UK: Five OPEC states produced over quota in Oct - OPECN.
newsitem.headline: Five OPEC states produced over quota in Oct - OPECN.

text.p: Five OPEC member states produced oil above their quota in October, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Friday.

Of the countries that have submitted output figures, the United Arab Emirates produced the largest surplus of 69,000 bpd, although only 41,000 bpd of this was supplied to the market, OPECNA said. The UAE told OPEC it produced 2.230 million bpd.
Algeria told the 11-member group it produced 797,000 bpd, 47,000 bpd over its allocation.
Libya said it produced 10,000 bpd over quota, Qatar announced a 18,000 bpd excess and Saudi Arabia said it overshot by 23,000 bpd.
Kuwait, Indonesia and Iran all said they produced within 5,000 bpd of their quotas, while Iraqi output was 460,000 bpd below, the report said.

OPEC quotas are determined according to market supply and not wellhead production. Supply, as defined by OPEC, is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawals of stocks held outside national boundaries.
All OPEC members except for Venezuela and Nigeria have submitted production data for October.
